## About
Brenda and Warner opened the doors of Mile High Billiards and turned their family passion into a hub for billiards lovers near and far. Their focus on cleanliness and quality equipment is what keeps people coming back to our room on W 64th Ave.
We support our local semi-pro and professional players, and we're just as happy to host anyone who wants to refine their shot, reconnect with friends, or just unwind. We offer league play, tournament play and regular table rentals.
You'll get to know our people. Nikki manages our BCA leagues, Hayley runs our tournaments, Dan takes care of cue repairs, and our bartenders keep the drinks coming. We hold a 4.4 rating from 418 Google reviews.

## Services
- Leagues: We offer a variety of leagues Monday through Thursday nights, with an hour of free practice before play starts at 7 PM.
- Thursday Night Tournament: Our Thursday night tournament is played on the big table. We also host weekly and monthly tournaments. (Entry $20 ($5 greens))
- Unlimited pool: Play as long as you like for $17.50 per player, every day. ($17.50 per player)
- Happy hour: All-day-long happy hour at the bar, every day from 11am.
- Table rentals: Regular table rentals for all players, from beginner to pro.
- Cue Stick Repairs: Dan diagnoses, repairs and refurbishes pool cues, including tip replacement, ferrule replacement and shaft cleaning.
- Lessons: Want to work on your game? Ask us about lessons.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get food while I play?
A: We don't have our own kitchen, but we have food options. One reviewer mentioned ordering Thai food, Dairy Queen and Blackjack Pizza from businesses around the bar.

Q: How late are you open on weekends?
A: Friday and Saturday we're open 11am to 12AM or later. Give us a call ahead for details.

Q: What nights do leagues play?
A: We offer a variety of leagues Monday through Thursday nights. Nikki manages our BCA leagues and can help you find a spot.

Q: Do I need to be a good player?
A: Not at all. Our leagues, tournaments and table rentals are for all players, from beginner to pro.

## What customers say
- "Love going here to play pool. They have around 20 or so tables and a bar but no one bugs you. The bar has good drinks and menus for good. It's $13 for an hr right now to have a pool table and they have 7ft and 9ft tables." (Becky Monroe, 5/5)
- "They don't have an actual kitchen there but you can order stuff from three different businesses located around the bar Thai food Dairy Queen and Blackjack Pizza tables are in awesome shape it's a cool place to go." (robbie secrist, 5/5)
